hypothesis: Adding exposure on a still-intact market or industry pullback is more useful than adding after a volume breakout.

rules.stock_trade: unchanged strict trend + daily MACD cross; next Open; structural support -5%; 2R; 40 sessions; stop first
rules.market_pullback: SPY and QQQ long trends intact; either index 3%-12% below prior 60D high and within 3% of EMA20/50
rules.industry_pullback: ETF long trend intact; 5%-20% below prior 60D high and within 3% of EMA20/50/200
rules.repair: MACD histogram rises for two completed sessions

comparison_reference.v1_hotspot_rule: ETF stacked uptrend + relative volume >=1.5 + 20D relative strength > SPY

limitations: Historical stock-theme membership remains unavailable, so industry testing trades the ETF proxy itself.
Signals overlap; results are not a capital-constrained portfolio.
Recent per-theme samples can be small.
Fees and quote-level slippage are excluded.
